name: G&G Industries
old_description: G&G Industries becomes the first manufacturer of Load Floors in North America using Polyurethane CSM Technology.
about:
G&G Industries was established in 1992 in Shelby Township, Michigan, initially operating as a fabric die cutter and converter.

The company specializes in honeycomb composite spray molding (CSM) for automotive interior trim and NVH components, operating four CSM cells with ten dedicated presses, two converting presses, and two honeycomb expanders in a 70,000-square-foot facility. It produces over 1.3 million composite panels annually and handles programs ranging from 10,000 to 500,000 units.

G&G serves the automotive industry as a supplier to OEMs and Tier 1 companies, with parts found in vehicles from Subaru (Outback, Legacy), BMW (X3, X5, X6), Mercedes-Benz (M-Class, E-Class, GLE, CLS), General Motors (Chevrolet Malibu, GMC Yukon, Tahoe, Suburban, Sierra, Silverado, Colorado, Canyon), Lexus (RX, ES), Toyota (RAV4, Camry, Avalon, Highlander), Stellantis (Jeep Grand Cherokee, Dodge Charger, Durango, Ram Truck), Ford (Escape), Nissan (Maxima), and Honda (Odyssey).

The company distinguishes itself as the first North American manufacturer to introduce honeycomb composite spray molding to the automotive sector (2004) and the first to produce load floors using polyurethane CSM technology. Its mission emphasizes becoming the preferred supplier of high-visibility interior trim and NVH components through quality-driven processes and customer satisfaction, guided by values of honesty, simplicity, participation, and continuous improvement.
